IRS990.MissionDesc: IDEAS42 USES BEHAVIORAL SCIENCE - THE SCIENCE OF HUMAN BEHAVIOR - TO IMPROVE LIVES, BUILD BETTER SYSTEMS, AND DRIVE SOCIAL CHANGE. WE WORK ACROSS MUTUALLY REINFORCING ISSUE AREAS INCLUDING: PROMOTING ACCESS TO QUALITY POST-SECONDARY EDUCATION AND HEALTHCARE, ADVANCING ECONOMIC AND LEGAL JUSTICE, AND STRENGTHENING CIVIC ENGAGEMENT. ACROSS ALL PROGRAMS, WE ENVISION A FUTURE WHERE APPLIED BEHAVIORAL SCIENCE FOSTERS OPTIMAL HEALTH, EQUITABLE OPPORTUNITY, AND ENVIRONMENTS AND SYSTEMS THAT ARE SUSTAINABLE AND JUST FOR ALL - ESPECIALLY THOSE WITH THE LEAST.
IRS990.Desc: ECONOMIC JUSTICE: WE'RE REDEFINING HOW PEOPLE THINK ABOUT POVERTY IN THE UNITED STATES TO PROMOTE EFFECTIVE AND INCLUSIVE POLICIES AND DESIGN NEW SOLUTIONS THAT PUT MORE PEOPLE ON A PATH TO ECONOMIC SECURITY. WORKING WITH GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND NONPROFITS, WE APPLY BEHAVIORAL SCIENCE TO FIX THE SYSTEMIC ISSUES CONTRIBUTING TO POVERTY IN THE U.S. BY INCREASING ACCESS TO THE CRITICAL RESOURCES OF TIME, MONEY, AND INFORMATION AND CHANGING HOW PEOPLE THINK ABOUT THE ROOT CAUSES OF POVERTY, WE ENSURE THAT MORE PEOPLE IN HISTORICALLY AND INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED COMMUNITIES HAVE GREATER CONTROL OVER THEIR LIVES AND FUTURES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: FINANCIAL HEALTH: WE'RE IMPROVING FINANCIAL SYSTEMS BY WORKING TO ENSURE PRODUCTS, SERVICES, AND PROGRAMS ARE BEHAVIORALLY INFORMED AND DESIGNED TO MEET THE NEEDS OF ALL PEOPLE. WE PARTNER WITH A WIDE VARIETY OF ORGANIZATIONS INCLUDING CREDIT UNIONS, BANKS, PUBLIC AGENCIES, GOVERNMENTS, FINTECH STARTUPS, AND NONPROFITS TO REDUCE FINANCIAL HARDSHIPS AND CREATE OPPORTUNITIES FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BEEN HISTORICALLY AND INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED. OUR ULTIMATE GOAL IS TO CREATE AN ECONOMIC SYSTEM THAT REDUCES DISTRESS AND CREATES OPPORTUNITIES FOR PEOPLE WITH LOW-TO-MODERATE INCOMES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: US HEALTH: WE'RE DESIGNING EVIDENCE-BASED SOLUTIONS THAT LOWER HEALTHCARE-RELATED FINANCIAL BURDENS ON INDIVIDUALS ACROSS THE UNITED STATES. BY FOCUSING ON CLINICAL INNOVATIONS, CHRONIC CONDITIONS, PUBLIC HEALTH SYSTEMS, AND DATA SCIENCE AND MACHINE LEARNING, WE PROMOTE BETTER OUTCOMES AND REDUCE DISPARITIES FOR HISTORICALLY AND INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED COMMUNITIES. WITH LEADING HEALTHCARE PARTNERS, WE CREATE MEASURABLE IMPACTS ON HEALTHCARE PARTICIPATION BY REMOVING BARRIERS AND BIASES HOLDING PEOPLE BACK.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: GLOBAL HEALTH: WE'RE TRANSFORMING GLOBAL HEALTH BY SUPPORTING PARTNERS TO BETTER STRUCTURE HEALTH PROGRAMS, SHARE HEALTH INFORMATION, AND SOLVE PERSISTENT PROBLEMS BASED ON HOW PEOPLE BEHAVE IN THE REAL WORLD. THROUGH BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF HOW AND WHY PEOPLE MAKE THE CHOICES THEY DO, WE'VE BROUGHT ABOUT INCREMENTAL AND LARGE-SCALE BEHAVIOR CHANGES THAT HAVE ADDRESSED CHALLENGES IN MATERNAL AND CHILD HEALTH, REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH, INFECTIOUS DISEASES, AND GENDER-BASED VIOLENCE. WORKING WITH HUMAN BEHAVIOR, RATHER THAN AGAINST IT, ENABLES MANY MORE WOMEN AND THEIR COMMUNITIES TO LEAD HEALTHY AND FRUITFUL LIVES.

CIVIC ENGAGEMENT: WE'RE BUILDING THE TOOLS AND ENHANCING THE PROCESSES NEEDED TO INCREASE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN CIVIC LIFE ACROSS THE UNITED STATES. BY LEVERAGING OUR UNIQUE ABILITY TO UNDERSTAND THE BARRIERS AND BEHAVIORS STANDING IN THE WAY OF PEOPLE EXERCISING THEIR RIGHT TO VOTE, WE CAN DESIGN INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS THAT STATE AND LOCAL PARTNERS CAN IMPLEMENT NATIONWIDE. BACKED BY OUR BEHAVIORAL SCIENCE EXPERTISE AND DATA-DRIVEN METHODOLOGY, IDEAS42 IS WORKING TO UPLIFT HISTORICALLY AND INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED COMMUNITIES AND BUILD A GOVERNMENT THAT BETTER REFLECTS THE COUNTRY.

GIVING: WE'RE REMOVING BARRIERS AND ENHANCING PROCESSES TO HELP DONORS ALIGN THEIR GIVING BASED ON THEIR FINANCIAL ABILITIES AND INTERESTS, INCREASING OVERALL CHARITABLE FUNDING AND IMPACT. BY ANALYZING THE PSYCHOLOGICAL AND BEHAVIORAL BARRIERS THAT OFTEN HINDER DONORS, WE CAN DESIGN, IMPLEMENT, AND TEST TOOLS THAT ENHANCE PHILANTHROPIC EFFORTS FOR NONPROFITS TACKLING THE HARDEST PROBLEMS FACING SOCIETY. THIS WORK BUILDS AND STRENGTHENS CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE ACROSS THE GIVING ECOSYSTEM, ENSURING MORE MONEY CAN BE PUT TO WORK BY THE ORGANIZATIONS SERVING PEOPLE WORLDWIDE.

GLOBAL DEVELOPMENT: WE'RE CREATING STRONGER FOUNDATIONS FOR INDIVIDUALS IN THE GLOBAL SOUTH BY WORKING WITH PARTNERS TO ENHANCE EXISTING PATHS TO SUSTAINABLE STANDARDS OF LIVING. BY CHANGING BEHAVIORS THAT HELP PEOPLE SEE THE VALUE OF LONG-TERM SOLUTIONS OVER SHORT-TERM GAINS, WE'VE REDESIGNED PROGRAMS AND SERVICES FOCUSED ON IMPROVING PEOPLE'S LIVELIHOODS, EDUCATION OUTCOMES, AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT. WITH PROJECTS IN EIGHT COUNTRIES WORLDWIDE, WE'VE DEVELOPED IMPACTFUL SOLUTIONS THAT MEET PEOPLE WHERE THEY ARE ON THEIR JOURNEY OUT OF POVERTY AND PUTS THEM ON A PATH TO ECONOMIC STABILITY.

POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION: WE'RE ENABLING MORE PEOPLE TO ACCESS AND COMPLETE COLLEGE IN THE UNITED STATES. BY WORKING WITH OUR POSTSECONDARY PARTNERS TO IDENTIFY AND REMOVE THE BEHAVIORAL BARRIERS THAT PREVENT PROSPECTIVE AND CURRENT STUDENTS FROM MATRICULATING AND PERSISTING, WE HELP MORE PEOPLE CONTINUE ON THEIR EDUCATIONAL JOURNEY. WITH POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION THE CLEAREST PATH TO UPWARD MOBILITY IN THE U.S. TODAY, OUR WORK HELPS THOUSANDS OF STUDENTS, INCLUDING FIRST GENERATION STUDENTS AND STUDENTS OF COLOR IMPROVE THEIR ECONOMIC WELL BEING.

SAFETY & JUSTICE: WE IMPROVE POSITIVE OUTCOMES WITHIN THE CRIMINAL LEGAL SYSTEM FOR HISTORICALLY AND INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED COMMUNITIES IN THE UNITED STATES. BY USING OUR RIGOROUS RESEARCH AND INNOVATIVE BEHAVIORAL DESIGN WORK, WE SEE HOW PROBLEMS LIKE MISSED COURT DATES HAVE OUTSIZED CONSEQUENCES ON PEOPLE. WITH JAIL TIME JEOPARDIZING EMPLOYMENT, ECONOMIC SECURITY, HOUSING, AND CHILD CUSTODY WHILE INCREASING RECIDIVISM RATES WE WORK TO CREATE BETTER SYSTEMS AND POLICIES SO MORE PEOPLE CAN RETAIN THEIR FREEDOMS, LIVELIHOODS, AND OVERALL WELL BEING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: OFFICERS, DIRECTORS AND TRUSTEES ARE REQUIRED TO ANNUALLY DISCLOSE INTERESTS THAT COULD GIVE RISE TO CONFLICT. IN CONNECTION WITH ANY ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, AN INTERESTED PERSON DISCLOSES THE EXISTENCE OF THE FINANCIAL INTEREST AND IS GIVEN THE OPPORTUNITY TO DISCLOSE ALL MATERIAL FACTS TO THE DIRECTORS AND MEMBERS OF COMMITTEES WITH GOVERNING BOARD DELEGATED POWERS CONSIDERING THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. AFTER DISCLOSURE OF THE FINANCIAL INTEREST AND ALL MATERIAL FACTS, AND AFTER ANY DISCUSSION WITH THE INTERESTED PERSON, HE/SHE LEAVES THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE MEETING WHILE THE DETERMINATION OF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST IS DISCUSSED AND VOTED UPON. THE REMAINING BOARD OR COMMITTEE MEMBERS DECIDE IF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS. PROCEDURES FOR ADDRESSING THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST: A) AN INTERESTED PERSON MAY MAKE A PRESENTATION AT THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE MEETING, BUT AFTER THE PRESENTATION, HE/SHE LEAVES THE MEETING DURING THE DISCUSSION OF, AND THE VOTE ON, THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT INVOLVING THE POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST. B) THE CHAIR OF THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE, IF APPROPRIATE, APPOINTS A DISINTERESTED PERSON OR COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE ALTERNATIVES TO THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. C) AFTER EXERCISING DUE DILIGENCE, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES WHETHER IDEAS42 CAN OBTAIN WITH REASONABLE EFFORTS FROM A DIFFERENT PERSON OR ENTITY A MORE ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT THAT WOULD NOT GIVE RISE TO A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. D) IF A MORE ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT IS NOT REASONABLY POSSIBLE UNDER CIRCUMSTANCES NOT PRODUCING A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES BY A MAJORITY VOTE OF THE DISINTERESTED DIRECTORS WHETHER THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT IS IN IDEAS42'S BEST INTEREST, FOR ITS OWN BENEFIT, AND WHETHER IT IS FAIR AND REASONABLE. IN CONFORMITY WITH THE ABOVE DETERMINATION, IT MAKES ITS DECISION AS TO WHETHER TO ENTER INTO THE TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. IF THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE HAS REASONABLE CAUSE TO BELIEVE THAT A MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, IT INFORMS THE MEMBER OF THE BASIS FOR SUCH BELIEF AND AFFORDS THE MEMBER AN OPPORTUNITY TO EXPLAIN THE ALLEGED FAILURE TO DISCLOSE. IF, AFTER HEARING THE MEMBER'S RESPONSE AND AFTER MAKING FURTHER INVESTIGATION AS WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES, THE GOVERNING BOARD OR COMMITTEE DETERMINES THAT THE MEMBER HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE AN ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, IT TAKES APPROPRIATE DISCIPLINARY AND CORRECTIVE ACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SALARY ADJUSTMENTS FOR THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR ARE DETERMINED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS IN THE ABSENCE OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. THE BOARD MAKES A DETERMINATION BASED ON COMPARATIVE SALARIES FOR SIMILAR-SIZED ORGANIZATIONS AND ON OVERALL PERFORMANCE. COMPARATIVE SALARIES ARE COMPILED BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE AND ARE SUBMITTED FOR REVIEW TO THE FULL BOARD. THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR'S COMPENSATION WAS DELIBERATED BY THE BOARD IN CLOSED SESSION AND THE FINAL DECISION WAS DOCUMENTED IN THE BOARD MINUTES. THE LAST COMPENSATION REVIEW TOOK PLACE IN DECEMBER 2023. THE COMPENSATION OF OTHER OFFICERS IS DETERMINED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR.
